choice_data_list: Did you get some good rest?
Did you get some good rest?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
In the country—the countryside—I drank 
spring water, and—walked through 
vineyards.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: —Once more—I ask of you. Our Training—.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Symboli Kris S appeared to have gotten a 
proper rest.
